note: RISK-ONLY REVIEW. Sanctions: OpenSanctions consolidated screening (aggregates OFAC SDN/Non-SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS and others; data current as of 2026-11-26) returned 'No matching entities were found' for 'ASV Multichemie' (https://www.opensanctions.org/search/?q=ASV+Multichemie). This is a NEGATIVE screening result, not a positive clearance: no direct query of the OFAC SDN search UI, UN Consolidated List, EU FSF or UK OFSI was completed, because the OFAC tool is a JavaScript form that returns no server-side results to http_get. Treat sanctions_hit as 'no match found in the sources actually queried', not as a certified clean screen. Court cases: Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'ASV Multichemie' and for 'ASV Multichemie OR "ASV Multi Chemie"' returned 'No matching results' (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22ASV%20Multichemie%22). Indian Kanoon covers reported judgments of the Supreme Court, High Courts, tribunals and many district courts, but NOT pending first-instance suits, NCLT/consumer-forum filings or arbitration, so absence here does not establish that no litigation exists. Party role and case status therefore null. Regulator actions and negative news: NOT ESTABLISHED. The DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable for the entire session ('Connection refused' on every query), Google returned HTTP 429, and Bing results for the exact phrase were dominated by unrelated 'ASV' entities (ASV loaders, ASV Inventions, American Society for Virology) with no hit on this company. No negative news, enforcement action, show-cause notice or SEBI/RBI/ED/IT action could be located or ruled out. Credit rating: null - no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action found or searchable; absence of a rating is normal for a small private chemical trader and is not itself adverse. Russia/CIS supply evidence: null - no customs, bill-of-lading, shipping or trade-flow record linking this entity to Russia or any CIS state was found; equally, no source was reachable that would have surfaced one. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the company's own registry footprint could not be read at all - ZaubaCorp and TheCompanyCheck both returned HTTP 403 and InstaFinancials returned 404 - so I could not confirm the entity's existence, incorporation state, directors or registered address. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground and I am not rejecting; but the risk picture here is 'nothing adverse found in the few sources that responded', which is materially weaker than 'verified clean'. Recommend a paid registry pull (MCA master data) and a direct OFAC/EU/UK list query before relying on this screen. No numbers, CINs, PANs or case references have been invented.
